candidateEvaluations.strategy: Present an immediate balance overview highlighting the 3,600 coins and calling attention to the 1,500 expiring points via a clean, non-urgent banner, paired with an instant reward grid tailored for rapid one-tap redemption without any countdown timers or notification fatigue triggers.

Focus on a re-engagement greeting via a customer choice panel offering instant redemption categories, supported by a quick redeem banner, avoiding partner comparisons and maintaining low-pressure navigation.

approvedCustomerStory.oneSentenceStory: Ryan inspects his 3,600 coin balance and effortlessly claims an instant reward to secure his expiring points without friction.
approvedCustomerStory.customerSituation: Returning after 41 days with 3,600 available coins, including 1,500 expiring in 7 days.
approvedCustomerStory.storyTension: Risk of losing expiring points balanced against recent inactivity and notification fatigue.
approvedCustomerStory.customerResolution: Selects a frictionless instant reward for immediate tangible value.
approvedCustomerStory.primaryOutcome: Claim an instant reward effortlessly to secure expiring points.
